why: The KMX front door must retain owned install routes, runnable first answer, the bundle journey, and runtime boundaries; fixture pairs detect lost markers and ordering.

mutations.name: the ketu icon matches anything
mutations.breaks: The compact project identity can disappear unnoticed.

mutations.name: the product line matches anything
mutations.breaks: The agent-specific promise can disappear unnoticed.
mutations.find: ("product line", r"^\*\*Agent Builder CLI for Kubernetes\.\*\*$"),

mutations.name: the runtime contract matches anything
mutations.breaks: The runtime ownership boundary may disappear.

mutations.name: the migration heading matches anything
mutations.breaks: The separate model bridge may disappear.

mutations.name: the experimental notice matches anything
mutations.find: ("experimental notice", r"^> \[!IMPORTANT\]\n> \*\*Kaimahi is experimental and under active development\.\*\*"),

mutations.name: the runtime ownership note matches anything
mutations.breaks: The front door could imply that KMX owns execution.
mutations.find: ("runtime ownership note", r"^> \[!NOTE\]\n> KMX is the Agent Builder and lifecycle layer, not a runtime or generic$"),

mutations.name: the Homebrew source accepts any tap
mutations.breaks: The README may direct readers to an unowned formula.

mutations.name: the Homebrew install is optional
mutations.breaks: An empty list validates any installation block.

mutations.name: the installer source accepts any URL
mutations.breaks: An untrusted script can satisfy the front door.

mutations.name: the Go install accepts any version
the first answer accepts a suffixed command
mutations.breaks: An obsolete non-command can look like the first answer.

mutations.name: the create marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: Bundle creation can disappear from the story.

mutations.name: the evaluate marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: Revision evaluation can disappear from the story.

mutations.name: the journey command list is emptied
mutations.breaks: Any prose validates the bundle journey.

mutations.name: the install order is ignored
mutations.breaks: A route may be placed before the prerequisite route.

mutations.name: the heading order is ignored
mutations.breaks: A set of headings replaces ordered navigation.
